title: 提莫 · 蘑菇小花园
description: 戴绿帽红护目镜的提莫，笑眯眯地给小花盆里的彩色蘑菇浇水。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: sage green, butter yellow, terracotta, warm brown, cream
art_direction.composition: Teemo from League of Legends, the tiny fluffy tan-furred adult yordle scout, with his recognizable round green scout cap, red-lensed goggles resting on the cap, little side ear flaps and a small feather. Cream muzzle, dark tiny nose, happy closed smiling eyes. Fully clothed in a simple moss-green scout jacket, soft brown shorts and little boots, with a tiny unmarked backpack. He crouches beside a low sunny windowsill and carefully waters three small potted decorative mushrooms using a round yellow watering can. Mushroom caps are friendly red, peach and lavender with simple spots; they are garden plants, never traps. Full-body side-three-quarter pose, fluffy cheeks and pleased expression. Two pale green window panes and a single sun patch are enough for the setting. No blowgun, darts, weapons or military action. Sage and yellow with warm terracotta pots.
